_comment: Coverage floor enforced in CI by check_ratchet.py. Raise these numbers whenever a change adds coverage; never lower them without a stated reason. CI merges Yosys v0.57 and v0.71 (scripts + C++ unit tests); the first merged run (v0.57 + v0.66) measured 93.2% lines / 67.9% branches, and the floor sits about a point below that. What is not covered, and why, is listed in UNREACHABLE.md.
